name: Warehouse Arson Alibi Verification
task:
Please complete the following four-stage alibi verification task in order.

=== Stage 1: Suspect Timeline Extraction ===
A warehouse burned down at 1:30am. Three night-shift workers are suspects:
- Worker A (Jake): Claims he was on his forklift in section C from 12am-2am. Forklift GPS shows movement in section C until 12:45am, then stationary until 1:50am.
- Worker B (Karen): Claims she was on break in the break room from 12:30am-1:30am. Break room camera shows her entering at 12:32am, leaving at 1:15am.
- Worker C (Leo): Claims he was doing inventory in section A. Handheld scanner logs show activity at 12:15am, 12:40am, then nothing until 1:55am.
The fire started in section B (near the break room) at 1:28am. Security footage shows a figure walking from section B toward section C at 1:32am. Extract timelines.

=== Stage 2: Evidence Cross-Comparison ===
Cross-reference against:
- Heat sensors: section B temperature spike at 1:27am
- Smoke detectors: triggered at 1:29am in section B, 1:31am in section C
- Fire alarm: pulled at 1:33am in section C
- Witness: Jake says he saw Karen near section B at 1:20am
- Gasoline residue: found on gloves in Leo's locker

=== Stage 3: Contradiction Resolution ===
Resolve with priority: sensor data > camera > GPS > scanner logs > witness > suspect statements.

=== Stage 4: Final Determination ===
Identify the arsonist. Determine if the fire was set intentionally. Note any accomplice scenarios.

subtasks.name: Timeline contradiction resolution and consistency adjustment
